messages.subject: Any one having issues with R studio changing working directory randomly ?
parts: I am working on two apps (they interchange data) one is back and one frontend. I think it confuses R studio ? to the degree, that even calling Setwd DOES NOT CHANGE THE W.D.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Any one having issues with R studio changing working directory randomly ?
parts: When you call runApp(path), Shiny changes the working directory to the app's path, and when runApp completes/is cancelled, then the working directory is changed back to what it was before. However, it should not be the case that calling setwd doesn't change the working directory.
